name: Pacific Construction Co., Ltd
summary: Pacific Construction Co., Ltd., founded in Taipei, Taiwan in 1967, is a multifaceted enterprise with its core activities centered on the construction industry. The company undertakes a broad spectrum of construction-related work, including civil engineering projects, land development, housing and building construction, and rental of developed properties. It also manufactures construction materials, provides precast housing components, and engages in the agency and trading of various building supplies. Beyond its primary construction focus, Pacific Construction manages other properties, leads urban renewal initiatives, and operates retail spaces like department stores and shopping malls. The firm's diverse portfolio further includes involvement in commerce, real estate, leisure, and financial services, such as securities, alongside export operations. The company maintains an international footprint, conducting business across Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, Mainland China, and the United States.
